reason: The three dominant bills give farmers the statement's own examples: capital-investment benefits equal to industry's (1, 5) and agricultural water pricing (2, 3). The rest are also direct farmer support: the Agriculture Law bills (4, 10, 12, 14, 22, 24), aid to border-area farmers (7), compensation for agricultural crime (9), rooftop farming (8, 16, 26) and tax relief for farmers who keep shmita (11, 17, 19). The statement fits all of them and names the cost to taxpayers and consumers.
